affiliate_program: TikTok Shop Affiliate Program lets creators earn commission by promoting products through videos, lives, and their showcase.
To join: TikTok Shop > Affiliate > Browse products in the Marketplace. No minimum follower count needed.
Commission rates vary by product, typically 10-30%. Some brands offer higher rates for top performers.
You earn commission on every sale through your affiliate link — from videos, lives, or showcase.
Creators can promote multiple brands simultaneously. There's no exclusivity unless a retainer deal says otherwise.
samples: To request samples: TikTok Shop > Affiliate > Product Marketplace > Find product > Request Sample.
Sample requests expire after a set period. If expired, just resubmit — totally normal.
Some products offer refundable samples — buy at sale price, get reimbursed after posting content.
Tips for approval: complete TikTok profile, some existing content in a relevant niche, and decent engagement.
Approval times vary from same day to a few days. You'll get a TikTok notification when approved.
spark_ads: Spark Ads let brands boost your organic videos as paid ads while keeping your handle visible.
To generate a Spark code: Video > Three dots > Ad Settings > Ad Authorisation ON > Set period > Copy Video Code.
Spark codes are typically valid for 30-60 days.
When brands run Spark Ads on your video, you still get all the engagement (likes, comments, followers).
Spark Ads can dramatically increase a video's reach — always submit your codes when asked.
content_best_practices: Hook viewers in the first 1-2 seconds. The scroll is fast — you need to stop them immediately.
Best formats: unboxing/first impressions, before/after, day-in-my-life with product, honest reviews, tutorials, GRWM.
Keep videos 15-60 seconds for best completion rates. TikTok rewards videos people watch to the end.
Post consistently — at least 1 video per day is ideal. The algorithm rewards frequent posting.
Best posting times: morning (7-9am), lunch (12-2pm), evening (7-10pm) in your audience's timezone.
Authentic > polished. Real, genuine content almost always outperforms overly produced videos.
Use trending sounds but make them relevant. Don't force a trend that doesn't fit your product.
Strong CTAs matter: 'link in bio', 'check my showcase', 'grab this before it sells out' — tell people what to do.
Film in good lighting (natural light is best), vertical format, and make sure audio is clear.
Batch filming saves time — shoot 5-7 videos in one session, then post them throughout the week.
hooks_that_work: POV hooks: 'POV: you finally found a product that actually works'
Problem-solution: 'I've been struggling with X until I found this'
Controversy/opinion: 'Unpopular opinion but this product is overhyped... or is it?'
Curiosity gap: 'I can't believe this only costs $X'
Social proof: 'This has 10,000 five-star reviews and I had to try it'
Urgency: 'This is selling out everywhere and I finally got my hands on it'
Relatability: 'Things I wish I knew before starting TikTok Shop'
going_live: Live selling lets you sell products in real-time. You can pin products and interact with viewers.
Flash sales during lives create urgency and boost conversions — ask the brand team to set these up before going live.
Optimal live duration: 1-2 hours minimum. The algorithm needs time to push your stream to more viewers.
Engage constantly — respond to comments, demo products, ask questions. Dead air kills viewership.
Best times for lives: evenings and weekends when more people are browsing.
Start by engaging for 10-15 minutes before pinning products — build an audience first.
Have products ready to demo. Showing the product in action converts way better than just talking about it.
Use good lighting and a clean background. Prop your phone at eye level.
algorithm: TikTok's algorithm prioritises: watch time, completion rate, shares, comments, saves, and replays.
The FYP (For You Page) is where most discovery happens. TikTok tests with small audiences first, then expands if it performs.
Engagement in the first 30-60 minutes after posting is crucial. Be active and respond to comments.
TikTok Shop content gets an algorithm boost when products are tagged — always add product links.
Consistency matters more than perfection. Post regularly and iterate based on what works.
Don't delete underperforming videos — it can hurt your account. Leave them up.
3-5 relevant hashtags is enough. Don't spam 20 hashtags.
TikTok detects and suppresses duplicate content. Don't copy other creators exactly.
common_mistakes: Switching niches too often confuses the algorithm — pick a lane and stick with it.
Don't buy followers or engagement. TikTok's algorithm will tank your reach.
Don't be too salesy. Integrate products naturally into content people already want to watch.
Don't ignore analytics. Check which videos perform best and make more of that type.
Don't give up after a few low-performing videos. It takes time to find what resonates.
metrics_to_track: Views: how many people see your content. Aim for consistent growth.
Engagement rate: (likes + comments + shares) / views. Above 5% is good, above 10% is great.
Completion rate: how many people watch to the end. This is the most important metric for the algorithm.
Conversion rate: clicks to purchase. Higher with good CTAs and authentic reviews.
GMV: Gross Merchandise Value — total sales generated. The ultimate measure of selling power.
